---
name: Bug report
about: Something doesn't run or a result looks wrong
labels: bug
---

**What happened** (one or two sentences)

**Command you ran** (e.g. `npm run scan -- --config scan.json`)

**Node version** (`node -v`) and OS

**Output / error** — please remove API keys and anything private first

**If a result looks wrong:** paste the answer text and say what you expected (recommended / not recommended / site cited). Each decision in the report shows the rule it used.
